newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged, stable trade seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged, stable trade seen.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed unchanged against the American counterpart in narrow-range trading on Saturday as continuous foreign fund inflows balanced recent rise of U.S. dollar overseas, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.486 to the dollar on a modest turnover of US$97.5 million. "Today's U.S. dollar supply and demand was quite balanced," said one dealer.
Dealers expected stable range of T$27.47-50 next week.
"Foreign equity funds should continue to flow in, and that should offset the factor of the rising U.S. dollar overseas," a dealer said. -- J.Peng (5080815)
